# UI user stories: plan-overview-rebuild

| ID | Persona / precondition | Browser actions | Interaction evidence | Expected observable result | Status | Evidence | Related work units | Run cache |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| US-84 | reviewer wanting to know why it looks plain | Click the tier indicator on a page running below the full tier | one left-click on the indicator | The page states which tier is active and why, distinguishing a measured step-down from the reduced-motion preference, so a plain-looking page is never mistaken for a broken one | 💤 untested | — | W73,W71,W69 | `ui-story-runs/US-84.md` |
| US-83 | reviewer with reduced motion on a fast machine | With the reduced-motion preference on, click into the graph and add a unit through the helper by typing the command and pressing Enter | one left-click, one typed command, one Enter | The minimal tier is pinned regardless of the measured framerate, no measurement raises it, and the state change is applied without motion | 💤 untested | — | W73,W66,W69 | `ui-story-runs/US-83.md` |
| US-82 | reviewer checking nothing is lost at the lowest tier | Force the minimal tier and click through every page type comparing against the full tier | one left-click per page type | Every value, status, anomaly and relationship present at the full tier is present at the minimal tier, differing only in effect; no tier hides a number, a link or a warning | 💤 untested | — | W73,W70 | `ui-story-runs/US-82.md` |
| US-81 | reviewer whose machine recovers | After the tier has stepped down under throttling, remove the throttle and click through three pages | three left-clicks | The tier steps back up after sustained headroom rather than staying degraded forever, and it does not oscillate while load varies around the threshold | 💤 untested | — | W74,W73,W69 | `ui-story-runs/US-81.md` |
| US-80 | reviewer on a slow or loaded machine | With CPU throttling enabled in the browser, click into the graph and type the helper command that adds a unit, pressing Enter | one left-click, one typed command, one Enter | The page steps down a cinematic tier rather than stuttering at full effect, states the tier it settled at, and every state change still occurs and is still visible | 💤 untested | — | W72,W73,W69 | `ui-story-runs/US-80.md` |
| US-79 | reviewer reading text over a translucent panel | Click into a unit page whose panel overlays a bright region of the background | one left-click | Text contrast is sufficient against the composited background rather than against the token colour, and no layering makes a value harder to read than a plain panel would | 💤 untested | — | W65,W70 | `ui-story-runs/US-79.md` |
| US-78 | reviewer who finds the effects distracting | Press the control that reduces visual effect, then click through two pages | one left-click on the control and two navigation clicks | Either a stated control reduces the effects while preserving every state change, or the page documents that the operating system preference is the only control; in both cases the reader can reach a calm reading of the same data | 💤 untested | — | W66,W51,W69 | `ui-story-runs/US-78.md` |
| US-77 | reviewer checking that style is not carrying meaning | Click through a status list, an anomaly on the graph and the activity indicator | three left-clicks | Every status, anomaly and activity state has a text or shape carrier as well as its colour, glow or motion, so nothing is lost to colour blindness, a monochrome display or reduced motion | 💤 untested | — | W70,W68,W64 | `ui-story-runs/US-77.md` |
| US-76 | reviewer on the largest plan during animation | Open the 337 KB fixture, click into the graph, and type the helper command that adds a unit, pressing Enter | one left-click, one typed command and one Enter | The recorded frame budget during the growth animation is reported as a number, and interaction remains responsive while it animates | 💤 untested | — | W69,W56 | `ui-story-runs/US-76.md` |
| US-75 | person glancing at the screen from across the room | Leave the served page open on a plan in implementing mode and click nothing for a minute | one left-click to focus the window, then no further input | Whether the plan is live and whether something is arriving is readable from a distance without reading any number, the indication is quiescent when nothing is arriving, and it never implies activity that is not occurring | 💤 untested | — | W68,W63 | `ui-story-runs/US-75.md` |
| US-74 | reviewer moving between pages | Click from the overview into a goal, then into a unit, then press the back control | three left-clicks | Each change animates as a transition rather than a cut, moving deeper and moving back are visibly different directions, and no transition delays the reader from acting on the arrived page | 💤 untested | — | W67,W74,W69 | `ui-story-runs/US-74.md` |
| US-71 | reviewer whose helper rewrites several files at once | Type a planning helper command that writes a step file, an inventory row and a progress row, press Enter, then click the page to confirm it settled | typed command, one Enter, one left-click | The burst produces one visible update rather than several redraws, and the stated debounce interval matches what was observed | 💤 untested | — | W59,W62,W63 | `ui-story-runs/US-71.md` |
| US-73 | planner comparing layout stability | Open the graph, note the position of three nodes, add a unit through the helper, then click one of the original three | one helper invocation and one left-click | The three original nodes are still where they were or moved minimally, the layout did not reshuffle, and the same plan opened twice lays out identically | 💤 untested | — | W54,W57,W40 | `ui-story-runs/US-73.md` |
| US-72 | reviewer reconnecting after a pause | Close the page, change the plan on disk, then reopen the page and click into a unit | one close, one external edit, one reopen and one left-click | The reopened page shows the current state rather than replaying missed events or showing the state from before the change | 💤 untested | — | W60,W63 | `ui-story-runs/US-72.md` |
| US-70 | reviewer keeping their place while the plan changes | Scroll a long unit page, expand a section, then edit an unrelated plan document on disk | one scroll, one expansion click, and one external edit | The page follows the change while preserving scroll position, the expanded section and the selected autoplay tab, and states when it last updated | 💤 untested | — | W61,W63 | `ui-story-runs/US-70.md` |
| US-69 | planner with reduced motion who still needs the change | With the reduced-motion preference on, add a unit through the helper and click the node | one helper invocation and one left-click | The same state change is applied without motion, the new node is still identifiable as new, and no information exists only in the animation that did not play | 💤 untested | — | W56,W51,W40 | `ui-story-runs/US-69.md` |
| US-68 | planner watching dependencies form | Record a dependency between two existing units through the helper, then click the new edge | one helper invocation and one left-click on the edge | The edge animates into place between the two nodes already on screen, and clicking it names both endpoints and offers navigation to either | 💤 untested | — | W56,W55,W40 | `ui-story-runs/US-68.md` |
| US-67 | planner watching a plan take shape | With the page served on a plan in planning state and autoplay on, add a work unit through the planning helper, then click the node that appears | one helper invocation and one left-click on the new node | The new node eases into the graph and its dependency edge draws from its source rather than the graph redrawing, the layout of existing nodes barely moves, and clicking the node opens its detail beside the graph without leaving the page | 💤 untested | — | W53,W54,W55,W56,W40 | `ui-story-runs/US-67.md` |
| US-66 | reviewer watching a plan cross from planning into implementing | With the page served and open, mark the first step in progress on disk, then click the mode indicator | one external state change and one left-click | The page moves from planning to implementing without a reload, states that the mode changed, and the surface that leads changes with it | 💤 untested | — | W51,W14,W13 | `ui-story-runs/US-66.md` |
| US-65 | reviewer opening a plan whose state is contradictory, on the empty-approved fixture that W96 checks in | Open a plan that is approved but has no steps at all, and read the mode the page reports | one left-click | The mode is reported as ambiguous because the fixture is approved but has zero steps. The page remains readable and explains the contradiction rather than guessing planning or implementing. | 💤 untested | — | W50,W52,W13 | `ui-story-runs/US-65.md` |
| US-64 | person opening a plan whose work is finished | Open a plan where every step and its verification have passed, with the page served, and click the autoplay control | one left-click on the control or its explanation | Autoplay states that a complete plan has no active subject to follow and offers no toggle that cannot move, rather than appearing engaged and doing nothing. An earlier version of this story claimed the same of planning state, which contradicts W53 and US-67: planning state is precisely where autoplay follows the graph being built. | 💤 untested | — | W53,W45 | `ui-story-runs/US-64.md` |
| US-63 | reviewer opening a finished plan, on the complete fixture that W95 checks in | Open a plan where every step and its verification have passed and click into the outcome surface | one left-click | The page states it is complete, leads with the outcome rather than an in-progress reading, and offers no current step or next action | 💤 untested | — | W50,W51,W13 | `ui-story-runs/US-63.md` |
| US-62 | reviewer following a plan mid-execution | Open an approved plan with several steps done and one in progress, and click the current step | two left-clicks | The page states it is in implementing state, leads with what is done, in progress and blocked, and the decomposition surfaces remain reachable without being primary | 💤 untested | — | W50,W51,W13 | `ui-story-runs/US-62.md` |
| US-61 | reviewer judging whether a plan is ready to execute | Open a plan whose review is pending and no step has started, and click through the soundness surfaces it leads with | three left-clicks | The page states it is in planning state, leads with decomposition, coverage and open findings rather than progress, and does not present zero progress as failure or show a next action that execution has not reached | 💤 untested | — | W50,W51,W13 | `ui-story-runs/US-61.md` |
| US-60 | reviewer reading a goal-size exception, on the anomalies fixture that W93 checks in | Open a single-unit goal and read its recorded exception | one left-click | The exception and its cited reason are shown with the goal, so a reader can judge whether the exception was legitimate rather than seeing only an unusually small goal | 💤 untested | — | W22,W29,W26 | `ui-story-runs/US-60.md` |

| US-58 | reviewer copying an identifier | Select a work-unit id with the mouse and copy it with the keyboard | one selection drag and one copy keypress | Ids are selectable as text rather than being baked into an image or blocked by the click handler, and copying yields the bare id without surrounding markup | 💤 untested | — | W23,W24,W26 | `ui-story-runs/US-58.md` |
